subject: Renewal QBR — proposed split-track roadmap demo, dry-run, and attendee matrix
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kim Lee <kim.lee@clearlinehealth.com>, procurement@clearlinehealth.com
Date: 2026-07-01T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal QBR / roadmap demo — week of Jul 19?

Hi Michael,

Hope you’re well. We’re kicking off renewal planning for Clearline and would like to combine the standard QBR with an expansion roadmap demo: we expect execs, platform owners, procurement, and security (roughly 8–12 people across US and EU).

Can you propose a format and a few time windows the week of Jul 19? Also:
- We’ll need a short pre-read (product changes + pricing summary).
- Security will want a slot to review our questionnaire.
- Procurement will need procurement/legal attendees for contract timeline conversation.

Appreciate a proposed agenda and who will own the runbook/dry-run.

Cheers,
Alex Ramos
Director of IT, Clearline Health
alex.ramos@clearlinehealth.com
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR / roadmap demo — week of Jul 19?

Alex — thanks for the context. Happy to run this as a combined QBR + expansion demo. Based on similar customers, we recommend a split-track format to keep execs and platform teams focused while preserving a single coordinated runbook. Proposal below:

Proposed high-level format (90–120 minutes total, can be split or contiguous):
- Exec track (30–45 min): renewal summary, ROI highlights, key roadmap items that matter to execs, ask/decision points.
- Technical track (60–75 min): deep-dive on performance, migration path for expanded capacity, hands-on demo of new batching/quantization flow, and security discussion.
- Closing & procurement (15 min): next steps, contract timeline, DocuSign touchpoints.

Options for scheduling (all times PST / should map to CET/APAC for attendees):
- Option A (single 120-min block): Jul 20, 10:00–12:00 PDT — contiguous, fewer context switches for execs.
- Option B (split, same day): Jul 20, 10:00–10:45 PDT (exec), 11:00–12:15 PDT (tech + security).
- Option C (split across days): Jul 20 10:00–10:45 PDT (exec); Jul 21 10:00–11:15 PDT (tech + workshop).

Attachments: I’ve attached a quick draft agenda (qbr-agenda-v1.pdf) and a runbook template (runbook-template.xlsx). Priyom will lead the runbook owner role and coordinate the dry-run.

Questions for you:
1) Which option do C-levels prefer (single condensed exec vs separate exec block)?
2) Who from security and procurement will join (names/emails)?
3) Any hard blackout dates during Jul 19–23 for your key stakeholders?

If you confirm Option B or C, we’ll schedule a dry-run 3–4 business days prior (we suggest Jul 16 or 17) and circulate a recording consent form.

– Michael Grant
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-04T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR / roadmap demo — week of Jul 19?

Alex — quick note from me on attendee logistics and runbook ops.

- If execs prefer a single tight conversation, I recommend 60 min for execs + a separate 75–90 min technical workshop the same day. That reduces C-level calendar burden while giving the platform team a hands-on block.
- For cross-region participants, we should avoid starting before 10:00 PDT to keep EU execs in normal hours.
- Dry-run: Jul 16 at 9:00–10:00 PDT works for our presenters — we’ll run the deck, screen share flows, and smoke the demo.

I’ll prepare a short pre-read (one-pager + 3-slide pricing summary) if you can confirm any key priority topics (e.g., latency reduction, committed throughput, private VPC options).

Thanks — Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kim Lee <kim.lee@clearlinehealth.com>, procurement@clearlinehealth.com
Date: 2026-07-06T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR / roadmap demo — week of Jul 19?

Thanks — Option B (split, same day) feels like the right balance for us. Quick adjustments:
- Exec track: condense to 45 min (high-level impact, decision ask).
- Tech track: expand to 75 min with a 15-minute security panel (Kim Lee will join for that).
- Procurement: please reserve the final 15 minutes for our procurement lead (procurement@clearlinehealth.com).

Confirmed attendees from our side:
- Alex Ramos (exec)
- Kim Lee (Security, kim.lee@clearlinehealth.com)
- Marcus Engel (Procurement, procurement@clearlinehealth.com)
- Platform owners: Jesse Park (jesse.park@clearlinehealth.com) and Elena Greco (elena.greco@clearlinehealth.com) — they’ll join the technical track.

Dry-run: Jul 16 at 9:00 PDT is good. I attached our current security questionnaire (CLH-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf) — Priyom, can you confirm who on your side will own completing the security follow-up and signature?

Looking forward to the agenda and pre-read.

Best,
Alex
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@clearlinehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-06T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR / roadmap demo — week of Jul 19?

Alex — I’ll own the security follow-up and coordinate with our engineering QA to populate the questionnaire responses. Action items I’ll take:
- Populate CLH-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf and return by Jul 14.
- Schedule dry-run on Jul 16 09:00–10:00 PDT and circulate calendar invites with runbook link (using the attached runbook-template.xlsx as the skeleton).
- Assign presentation owners and test the demo environment (test endpoint: prod-like staging cluster).

Naomi — can you confirm the recording/consent wording we should use in the calendar invite?

Thanks — Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
